metadata.title: WR-VII: Energy-Time Frontiers of World Realizability — Calibrated quantum responses, action bounds and generator ambiguity (v0.2)
metadata.description:
English mathematical draft and complete Russian translation. WREH studies calibrated response completion. This finite closed-unitary model proves a spectral-diameter action certificate and a sharp qubit energy-duration frontier, enumerates compatible constant generators and separates final-state identification from generator identification. Deterministic intervals and fixed iid repetitions have distinct feasibility and coverage certificates.

Полный русский перевод включён в ту же запись. Работа рассматривает калиброванный конечномерный квантовый носитель, спектральный диаметр в джоулях, длительность в секундах и неоднозначность генератора на точном ресурсном рубеже.

REVIEWABLE_DRAFT. Not externally peer reviewed; no priority or universal cosmological-boundary claim. Content and analytic figures: CC BY 4.0. Executable scripts and HTML code: MIT. Prepared description only; this version has not been deposited.
